name: Lekarstvo ot Lichnosti
source: On a cold summer day, an Elder Man comes to you for help. He asks you to buy a trinket, but only wants 1 ruble for it. You ask yourself: "How can one ruble help someone?" However, you will soon find out that the item you received is not useless, and the help was not about money at all.
translation: On a cold summer day, an Elder Man comes to you for help. He asks you to buy a trinket, but only wants 1 ruble for it. You ask yourself: "How can one ruble help someone?" However, you will soon find out that the item you received is not useless, and the help was not about money at all.
